description: Agent Limits: submit a limit set with what each side can observe: for each limit, what the agent can read (the limit and its remaining headroom, the limit only or nothing) and when (before acting, only on refusal or after acting), what the owner can read and when (before money moves, after settlement, in a periodic report or only on a breach), where the headroom shown comes from (the live count, a cached copy or an estimate) and when anyone is warned. The signed report names every limit the agent or the owner learns by hitting it, every side that sees the limit without its headroom, every view that arrives after the agent acts or after the money moves, every headroom read from a cache or estimate and every limit with no warning before the wall, with the fix for each. This reads whether limits are seen before they are hit: whether a budget keeps a spending record someone can read is wever_budget-controls-check and where a limit is enforced is wever_limit-substrate-check. Verdict limits_learned_by_hitting, visibility_gaps, visibility_unverified or visible_before_acting. POST /api/limit-visibility-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

limits.description: Each limit with what the agent and the owner can each observe.

agent_sees.description: What the agent can read about this limit.

headroom_source.description: Where remaining headroom comes from: the live count, a cached copy or an estimate.

owner_sees.description: What the owner can read about this limit.

warns_at.description: When anyone is warned, such as 80% used.
